verses.pali: “Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā viraddhā, viraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: “Mendicants, whoever has missed out on the four bases of psychic power has missed out on the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā āraddhā, āraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: Whoever has undertaken the four bases of psychic power has undertaken the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti,
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant develops the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to enthusiasm …

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ime cattāro iddhipādā viraddhā, viraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: Whoever has missed out on these four bases of psychic power has missed out on the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ime cattāro iddhipādā āraddhā, āraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī”ti.
verses.english: Whoever has undertaken these four bases of psychic power has undertaken the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.”
